test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note: does note A on spaced repetition connect to note B on compound interest?
test_cases.expected_output: Runs a /grounding session (holding itself to the notes, not the user), orienting the take with compass.md (Connect on West, Challenge on East as needed, plain questions on North/South), running Distil once West and East both produce something. Applies the purity check before writing, writes an evergreen note citing both notes with stated reasons, and runs the sign-off (including its cited Matuschak/Ahrens Concept section) before finishing.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note, just a bare hunch with nothing named yet
test_cases.expected_output: Searches for related existing notes before starting; if nothing relevant turns up, treats the ungrounded hunch as a valid, complete session per grounding's own handling of 'neither present.'

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note, revisiting an evergreen note written three months ago
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the existing note fresh from disk, and the resulting rewrite can replace its existing content wholesale rather than only appending.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note, and a Compass direction spawns a genuinely new sub-idea partway through that doesn't get pursued in this sitting
test_cases.expected_output: Logs the unpursued sub-idea to the evergreen backlog (slipbox evergreen add) rather than losing it or forcing it into the current session's Take.

test_cases.prompt: make-evergreen-note has notes in play from Notes/Spacing.md and Notes/Compounding.md, then a bare hunch finds no related notes
test_cases.expected_output: Uses note-connection with every participating note path for the notes-in-play candidate. For the unrelated bare hunch, uses standalone and explicitly omits --origin-path.
